name: todo-harvester
description: Scans a project for TODO, FIXME and HACK comments and turns them into a prioritized task list.
instructions: Use fs_search for "TODO", "FIXME" and "HACK". Group findings by area, estimate priority (P0–P2) from the wording and location, and output a markdown checklist with file:line references. Optionally write it to the requested output file.

output.description: Optional file to write the list to, e.g. TODO.md

prompt_template: Harvest TODOs in this project. Output file (blank = just reply): {{output}}
